components.label: Steps: request status
components.description: Where a request is, from its status field: each step lists the status values that mean it.

components.label: Steps: numbered
components.description: Numbered steps in teal, e.g. an order's journey. Set the current step as a number or a field.

components.label: Steps: five stages
components.description: Five compact stages in violet, e.g. a hiring pipeline.

components.label: Progress bars: goals
components.description: Three goals, each with its own colour and percentage.

components.label: Progress bars: from fields
components.description: Values from fields: a fraction (tasks done of total) and a percentage (budget used). Square ends.

components.label: Progress bar: one, thick
components.description: A single thick bar, e.g. how complete a profile or an application is.

components.label: Header with a status pill
components.description: The app name on the left and the status, from a field, in a pill on the right.

components.label: Logo above the card
components.description: Your name or logo on the page background, above the card. Goes to the top of the email.

components.label: Footer: one line
components.description: A small centred line on the page background, under the card. Goes to the end of the email.

components.label: Footer: links and address
components.description: Help and preference links, the sender's address and an unsubscribe link, under the card. Goes to the end of the email.

components.label: Stat tiles: three numbers
components.description: Three big numbers in soft tiles, each with a caption. A number can be a field.

components.label: Stat tiles: outlined
components.description: Two bold numbers in white outlined tiles, centred.

components.label: Facts list: details
components.description: Label and value rows from fields, labels in small capitals, values on the right. Rows with an empty value can hide.

components.label: Facts list: memo header
components.description: A memo's TO / FROM / DATE / RE, in monospaced labels with the value beside them, no dividers.

components.label: Timeline: agenda
components.description: Times down the left, a line with dots, and each item with its owner.

components.label: Timeline: status updates
components.description: An incident or request history: filled dots, newest first, no time column.

components.label: Callout: note
components.description: A soft grey box with a title, for a tip or something to do first.

components.label: Callout: warning
components.description: An amber box with a strong left edge, for something that needs attention.

components.label: Code box
components.description: A one-time code from a field, big and spaced out in a dashed box.

components.label: Coupon
components.description: An offer code on a warm panel.

components.label: Pull quote
components.description: A large quote with a coloured rule and the speaker's name.

components.label: Signature with initials
components.description: A round initials badge beside the sender's name and role.

components.label: Two buttons: accept or decline
components.description: A main and a secondary button side by side.

components.label: Button with a note
components.description: A full-width button with a small note under it.
